name: dsp-nebula-control
description: A safety-first control plane for Dyson Sphere Program and Nebula multiplayer servers.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/api run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api run test && npm --prefix apps/web run test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
